MaxSpawnCount.notes: Sets UEnemyDescriptor.MaxSpawnCount (rounded to int). Default: the descriptor's current value. MinUpdateInterval 0.1. Key list = CD2_EEnemyDescriptor_Floats display names (CD2_SM_ED.cpp:31).

MinSpawnCount.notes: Sets UEnemyDescriptor.MinSpawnCount (rounded to int). Default: the descriptor's current value. MinUpdateInterval 0.1. Key list = CD2_EEnemyDescriptor_Floats display names (CD2_SM_ED.cpp:31).

UsesBiomeVariants.notes: false clears BiomeEnemyClassOverrides (no biome-specific class swaps); true restores the default map. Incompatible with CustomVeterans.

DisplayName.notes: Raw string (not mutatable): sets the pawn's InGameName. Non-string -> 'DisplayName must be a string'.

options.notes: JSON bool literal: true = chance 1, false = chance 0 (not mutatable).

Elite.notes: Chance (0..1) a spawned pawn gets BP_MOD_MakeElite, rolled from the pawn's replicated RandomSeed ((seed%1000)/1000 < chance). Also makes CD2_EC_Materials re-apply materials on clients.

ForceEliteBase.notes: ED name set as SpawnedFromDescriptor on pawns made elite (else Base is used). Only acts when Elite is set. Unknown name -> null descriptor, no error.

EnemyHealthScaling.notes: Sets UEnemyHealthComponent.EnemyHealthScaling. Unknown value: runtime log 'Unrecognized EnemyHealthScaling X', no load error.

HealthMultiplier.notes: Max health = default max health * value (health % kept). Values <= 0 ignored. Mutually exclusive with HealthRaw.

HealthRaw.notes: Absolute max health (health % kept). If HealthMultiplier is also set -> error 'Only HealthRaw or HealthMultiplier, but not both, can be set' (and HealthRaw then also reports Unrecognized Enemy Field).

options.notes: Number/array/string/bool/null or an object WITH a 'Mutate' key: one float (HP/s).
Object WITHOUT 'Mutate' = two-phase rate. Unknown key -> 'Unrecognized Field "X"'. Note a {"Var":..} object lands here and 'Var' is rejected.

Heal.notes: Health per second (negative = damage); applied every 0.25 s tick (x0.25).

NoSpawnWithin.notes: Distance: a spawned pawn within this distance of any player character is destroyed (CD2_EC_NoSpawnWithin.cpp:119).

Twerking.notes: Raw string dance id. BROKEN: a string always also emits error 'Invalid Dance ID' (CD2_EC_Twerking.cpp:27); non-string -> 'Twerking must be a string'.

AttackDamageMultiplier.notes: Adds a PawnStats modifier on pawn stat PST_DamageBonus (value clamped 0.0001..1e6, CD2_EC_PST_CritChance.cpp:166).

PST_DamageFromPlayers.notes: Adds a PawnStats modifier on pawn stat PST_DamageFromPlayers (value clamped 0.0001..1e6, CD2_EC_PST_CritChance.cpp:166).

MovementSpeedPenaltyReduction.notes: Adds a PawnStats modifier on pawn stat PST_MovementSpeedPenaltyReduction (value clamped 0.0001..1e6, CD2_EC_PST_CritChance.cpp:166).

PST_CritBonusDamage.notes: Adds a PawnStats modifier on pawn stat PST_CritBonusDamage (value clamped 0.0001..1e6, CD2_EC_PST_CritChance.cpp:166).

Materials.notes: One entry per material slot, walked across all mesh components in order. '' or 'Default' keeps the slot, 'Random' picks a random registry material, else a Material registry name (unknown: runtime log "Unrecognized Material 'X'", slot kept) (CD2_EC_Materials.cpp:320).

Type.notes: Literals checked at load: 'Unrecognized Outline Type'.

Outline.notes: Non-object -> '{name} Must Be a JSON Map'. Unknown key -> 'Unrecognized Field ""' (field name not filled in).

Resource.notes: Literals checked at load: 'Unrecognized Resource Type'.

GoombaOnly.notes: only drop when killed by Goomba stomp (presumed from name)

DropResource.notes: Drops a resource chunk on death. Non-object -> '{name} Must Be a JSON Map'. Unknown key -> 'Unrecognized Field "X"'.

Enable.notes: BUG: registered as 'Enable' but read as 'Enabled' (CD2_EC_Goomba.cpp:219), so it has no effect; always enabled.

DamageType.notes: Damage class name; literals checked at load: 'Unrecognized Damage Type(s)' (CD2_DamageClass_String.h:12).

Goomba.notes: Players can stomp the pawn. Non-object -> '{name} Must Be a JSON Map'. Unknown key -> 'Unrecognized Field "X"'.

values.notes: Type chosen by the key prefix, not the JSON value.

values.notes: Per-enemy config. Enemies.notes: Key = enemy (descriptor) name. Hash Collsion on X (hash)' / 'Duplicate X' (Enemies.cpp:767).

registries_mod_provided.notes: The ED registry is filled at runtime from the asset registry (every EnemyDescriptor asset, after scanning /Game/yinnys_addon and /Game/NewEnemies; CD2_ED_Registry.cpp:82). These EDs exist only when those other mods are installed (from a modded Dumper-7 object dump). Plus every name defined as a key of Enemies in the same config.

registries_notes.ED: Vanilla DRG EnemyDescriptor object names (Dumper-7 vanilla dump, build 4.27.2-158958; cross-checked with the game pak's ED_* files). Registry = runtime asset-registry scan, no table in source (CD2_ED_Registry.cpp:68). 'Base' accepts only these (DefaultNames); other ED references also accept CD2-defined names.
registries_notes.PRJ: Registry = every BlueprintGeneratedClass whose native parent derives AProjectile or whose asset name starts 'PRJ_', kept if the loaded class is an AProjectile (CD2_PRJ_Registry.cpp:111); name = class name incl. '_C' (writing without '_C' also works). List = vanilla SDK AProjectile BP subclasses + pak PRJ_* assets (PRJ_ZipLineGun* unverified: not loaded in the dump).
registries_notes.Material: Registry = every MaterialInstanceConstant asset name (CD2_Material_Registry.cpp:111). List = MICs loaded in the vanilla dump: a lower bound, the cooked asset registry may hold more. Materials also accepts 'Default' and 'Random'.
